search_window.basis: From verified preceding hourly watch completion to this run. Discovery may retrieve articles published shortly before the preceding run completed; event and publication times are not assumed equal to discovery time.

findings.title: Woman injured by Israeli fire in Gaza's Bureij refuee camp; rooftop targeted in Nuseirat
findings.location: Near the entrance to Al-Bureij refugee camp, central Gaza; separately rooftop of a house in nearby Nuseirat refugee camp
findings.affected_population_system: One Palestinian woman with a reported Israeli gunshot injury received by Al-Awda Medical Complex in Nuseirat; a rooftop in Nuseirat reportedly targeted separately, with no verified injuries or extent of property damage there
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Medical sources at Al-Awda Medical Complex in Nuseirat reported receiving a woman injured by Israeli fire
findings.source_type: Palestinian national news agency directly attributing injury to medical sources at Al-Awda Medical Complex; separate reported targeting of rooftop not independently verified

bounded_discovery_context.discovered_via: Direct read of WAFA latest-news index, canonical English report and Arabic-language counterpart after official-first checks; additional search confirmed identical report
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Previously unlogged 23 Nov injury in central Gaza; distinct from prior recorded 23 Nov Jabalia worker death, Jabalia mosque injuries, Khan Younis injury and 19 Nov Bureij-related casualty
bounded_discovery_context.publication_relative_to_prior_watch: WAFA English publication 14:49 local Gaza time (=04:49 PST), roughly 1 minute 54 seconds before previous watch completed at 04:50:54 PST; newly recovered rather than first published inside the current observation interval
bounded_discovery_context.corroboration: WAFA attributes casualty to medical sources at Al-Awda Medical Complex; same-agency Arabic article published at 14:43 Gaza local time; no independent second outlet verified
bounded_discovery_context.deduplication: Do not add to the 23 Nov Ministry of Health daily aggregate (4 fatalities, 7 injured) without confirmed non-overlap. Different geographic incident from prior Jabalia or Khan Younis reports.
bounded_discovery_context.caution: The report establishes one medically received wound according to WAFA; no named patient, severity, exact incident time, independent Israeli statement, or verified injury from separate Nuseirat rooftop targeting.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary Gaza recall watch only; primary Gaza collector/publisher remains authoritative.
